Looking for a CD player for your car? There are several options, even if your car doesn't have a built-in CD player.

Shop

1. External USB car CD player

Plugs into a compatible car USB port. Usually costs around $60–$150. Not all car stereos support USB CD players.

Shop

2. Car stereo with built-in CD player

Replaces your existing stereo. Usually $80–$250 before installation. Best for cars that support aftermarket head units.

Shop

3. Portable CD player with AUX

Connects through your car's AUX input. Usually $25–$80. Some models also support Bluetooth or FM transmission.
